input.change_text: Breaking change: Removed deprecated Windows managed settings fallback at `C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json` — use `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json`

output.subject: Windows managed-settings.json fallback path removed
output.action_text: Move `C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json` to `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json` on every Windows host BEFORE upgrading Claude Code to 2.1.75+. The old fallback path is no longer read; enterprise deployments using the deprecated location will silently lose managed settings.
